name: Claude Code v2.1.214 — EndConversation Tool; Permission Hardening; Progress Heartbeat; Day 2
hook: Released July 18. Five headline changes: (1) EndConversation tool — Claude can now end sessions involving highly abusive users or persistent jailbreak attempts, the first explicit session-ending safety valve in Claude Code; (2) permission system hardening: dir/** allow rules no longer auto-approve nested writes, Windows PowerShell 5.1 bypass fixed, docker commands with daemon-redirect flags now prompt; (3) periodic progress heartbeat for long-running tool calls so sessions don't appear frozen; (4) stream-json output no longer truncates at exit; (5) background sessions that went idle can now be properly deleted via `claude rm`. v2.1.215 (July 19) adds one follow-up fix: /verify and /code-review skills now only run when explicitly invoked.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 2 — v2.1.215 shipped same day with one behavioral fix

name: chainbase-labs/Agentkey — 481 Stars; Day 2; One Plugin for Live Web, Crypto, Finance & Social Data
hook: AgentKey v1.12.0 (July 17) is a single Claude Code plugin that routes agent requests to a live data marketplace: web search, article scraping, crypto/on-chain prices, stock quotes and technicals, social media posts, e-commerce listings, and business/funding data. No per-provider API keys, no separate accounts — one install, one bill. Targets the 'context retrieval gap' where Claude Code has to juggle six different MCP servers for real-time data. Free tier available.
install: claude plugin marketplace add chainbase-labs/agentkey && claude plugin install agentkey@agentkey
